zh.text: @TheTranscript_ 分享 $JPM JPMorgan Chase 高管 Charles Bristow：AI 驅動的存款流動性最終可能通過削弱銀行資助長期貸款的能力而提高全經濟體的借貸成本。指出存款速度越高，對期限資產的需求越少。

en.text: @TheTranscript_ shares $JPM JPMorgan Chase Executive Charles Bristow: AI-driven deposit mobility could ultimately raise economy-wide borrowing costs by undermining banks' ability to fund long-term loans. Notes higher velocity in deposits means less demand for duration-bearing assets.

zh.text: 作者對NASA的100億美元合約開始月球定居感到興奮。選定$SPCX（SpaceX）、Blue Origin、$FLY（Firefly）、$LUNR（Lunar）、$LMT、$NOC、$VOYG、iSpace US競爭未來月球運送任務。包括13億美元發射訂單、9400萬美元給Blue Origin的探測車、CLPS上限提升至42億美元，以及$RDW的月球電力塔獎項。

en.text: Author excited about NASA's $10 Billion contract to begin settling on the moon. Selected $SPCX (SpaceX), Blue Origin, $FLY (Firefly), $LUNR (Lunar), $LMT, $NOC, $VOYG, iSpace US to compete for future lunar delivery missions. Includes $1.3B launch orders, $94 million for Blue Origin rover, CLPS ceiling raised to $4.2B, and $RDW award for lunar power tower.

zh.text: 作者認為「AI泡沫」標籤被過度用於基礎設施相關公司。從三星到$ESMT的記憶體公司遠期市盈率僅1-3倍，且高頻寬記憶體廠商已簽下超大規模企業多年價格底線長期協議。光學公司$POET交易價格低於淨現金9700萬美元。$COHR簽署200億美元長期協議，$LITE簽署50億美元長期協議。作者對瓶頸領域復蘇有信心，隨著盈利與自由現金流累積，更像是2026年AI大去槓桿而非需求破壞。

en.text: Author argues the "AI Bubble" label is overused for infrastructure names. Memory companies from Samsung to $ESMT trade at 1-3x forward P/E with hyperscaler multi-year HBM price floor LTAs. Optical $POET trades $97M under net cash. $COHR signed $20B LTAs and $LITE $5B LTAs. Confident in recovery especially in bottlenecks as earnings and FCF accumulate, calling it more the Great AI Deleveraging of 2026 than demand destruction.
